Matches the plan hook 'Sa mesazhe mbetën pa përgjigje këtë javë?' and the self-check ask ('Numëroji para se të paguash për më shumë reklama'): empty clinic reception, phone full of messages, nobody answering.

No people or hands in the image (the alt text asks for an empty reception).
No hands.
No faces.
The phone lies flat on the lacquered desk with a matching red reflection under its edge; the brass bell stands on its base with a reflection; the pen rests on the ledger cover. Nothing floats.

Phone: one case, side buttons on one edge, one port with speaker holes, one home indicator. Bell: base, dome, plunger. Ledger: one cover and one page block. Window frames and the desk front edge are straight; background chairs stand on the floor.

The extra kicker 'PYETJA E JAVËS' (Ë correct) is the optional label of 6 words or fewer that STANDARDS 6 allows; it is not in the alt text, so add it there ('Pyetja e javës') for accessibility. No ç occurs in the image text.
All copy sits on the calm dark upper wall and on its own crimson bar; nothing passes in front of or through the letters; no text on objects except the phone UI (V11).
